input.content:
# November campaign brief: "Book the desk, skip the guesswork"

**Owner:** Sam Ortiz · **Dates:** Monday, November 16 to Sunday, December 13, 2026 · **Product:** Acme Desk Pro, first month free for new teams

## Goal
120 trial sign-ups from offices of 10 to 200 people (October: 74). Cost per sign-up under $75 (October: $82).

## Message
- **One line:** "See who is in, book a desk in two taps."
- **Proof:** Harbor Labs cut empty desks from 40% to 15% in two months (approved by Harbor Labs).
- **Avoid:** "the best", "number one", numbers we cannot show.

## Budget: $12,000 (Marketing Q4 budget)
- Ads: $9,000. Plan: search $5,000, LinkedIn $4,000. Decided November 3: search gets $500 more of the ads budget.
- Content: $3,000 (two short videos, one customer story)

## Channels and timing
| Channel | What | When |
|---|---|---|
| Website | Landing page with a 2-minute product tour | Live Monday, November 16 |
| Search ads | "desk booking app", "hot desk software" | November 16 to December 13 |
| LinkedIn | Two videos for office managers | November 18 to December 10 |
| Newsletter | Customer story and the free month | Thursday, November 19 and Thursday, December 3 |

## Status (November 3)
Landing page copy is final. The two LinkedIn videos are in editing. In October, search did better than LinkedIn.

## Key tasks
| Owner | Task | Due |
|---|---|---|
| Jordan Lee | Search ads: new keywords and the extra $500 | Monday, November 9 |
| Jordan Lee | Final cut of the two LinkedIn videos | Wednesday, November 11 |
| Alex Kim | Draft the November 19 newsletter | Thursday, November 12 |
| Alex Kim | Collect three customer quotes for the landing page from Sales | Friday, November 13 |
| Sam Ortiz | Sign off the landing page and the videos | Friday, November 13 |

## How we measure
Trial sign-ups · cost per sign-up (target under $75) · trials that become paid within 30 days

*Sources: groups/Marketing/november-campaign-plan.md; groups/Marketing/meetings/2026-11-03-marketing-weekly.md*
